title: Why getting your data in order is key to enabling “speed to trusted action” for the energy transition
summary: Utilities are dealing with exponential growth in the volume and complexity of data. At the same time, they are readying for the energy transition by preparing networks to support electrification and increased use of renewable energy resources, like wind, solar and tidal, which are intermittent and less dependable. To be successful, utility leaders need to make the right decisions at the right time. This requires data to be at the heart of the decision-making process. It must be accurate, reliable, complete, relevant and timely to help guide and prioritize decisions.
